moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is the current UK Singles Chart Number 1 for the week of August 6-12, and has now spent an incredible 20 non-consecutive weeks at the top, making it the longest-running UK number-one single of all time.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its incredible run on the Official Singles Chart. Is it your favourite right now?

angles.name: Making History
angles.copy: History made! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is now the longest-running UK Number 1 single of all time with 20 non-consecutive weeks. An absolute anthem!
